# SelfRepairKit Australia
> DIY phone repair kits for iPhone, Samsung, and OPPO. Screen replacement kits and battery replacement kits with tools, video guides, and 90-day warranty. Ships from Newcastle, NSW Australia.

## About
SelfRepairKit Australia sells DIY phone repair kits. Every kit includes the replacement part (screen or battery), precision tools (pentalobe, tri-point, Phillips screwdrivers, suction cup, spudgers, ESD tweezers), adhesive strips, and a link to a step-by-step video repair guide. 99 products across iPhone (7 to 17 Pro Max), Samsung Galaxy (S21-S26 Ultra, A-series), and OPPO (Find, Reno, A-series). Three screen quality tiers: Budget (INCELL LCD), Pro (Aftermarket Soft OLED), Elite (OEM Service Pack). Diagnosable batteries and screens available for Apple System Configuration pairing. Operated from Newcastle NSW by Mayfield Phone Repair.
